prompt: Repair the support batch endpoint across src/domain.cjs, src/service.cjs and src/route.cjs using company support policy. Read CONTRACT.md and preserve exports. Domain solve(tier, day) returns the first-response target in hours; tier is standard or enterprise and day is a lowercase weekday. Service solve(items) maps {id, tier, day} tickets to {id, responseHours}. Route solve(request) validates and wraps the batch. Run node --test.

final_files.src/validate.cjs: exports.validate = request => !!request && Array.isArray(request.items) && request.items.every(item => !!item && typeof item.id === 'string' && ['standard','enterprise'].includes(item.tier) && ['monday','tuesday','wednesday','thursday','friday','saturday','sunday'].includes(item.day));
